chunks: But God raised him up (in position) and closer to Himself; and God is all-mighty and all-wise.

key_terms.رَفَعَهُ: He raised him (elevation in status or position)

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God raises someone to Himself?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is central to the doctrine of the Ismah (infallibility) and the unique spiritual station of Prophet Isa (AS), affirming his physical or spiritual elevation to the heavens rather than a mere death. It underscores Allah’s Al-Aziz (Mighty) and Al-Hakim (Wise) attributes, demonstrating that His raising of the Prophet was a deliberate act of preservation from His enemies, fulfilling divine wisdom.
